Windows-Specific Implementation:

impl UdpComm {
    pub fn new() -> Result<Self, UdpError> {
        // Try primary port
        let receiver = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:7872")
            .or_else(|_| UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:7873"))?;
        
        let transmitter = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")?;
        transmitter.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        
        Ok(Self {
            receiver,
            transmitter,
            target_ip: Ipv4Addr::new(127, 0, 0, 1),
        })
    }
}

pub struct Instance {
    system_id: SystemId,
    refresh_rate: f32,
    udp: Arc<UdpComm>,
}

impl Instance {
    pub fn new() -> Result<Self, InitError> {
        let udp = Arc::new(UdpComm::new()?);
        Ok(Self {
            system_id: SystemId(0),
            refresh_rate: 90.0,
            udp,
        })
    }
    
    pub fn now(&self) -> XrTime {
        use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
        XrTime(SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_nanos() as i64)
    }
}

Session Management with UDP Thread:

pub struct Session {
    system_id: SystemId,
    state: SessionState,
    udp: Arc<UdpComm>,
    latest_pose_data: Arc<RwLock<Option<WinlatorPoseData>>>,
    pose_receiver_thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
    shutdown_signal: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

impl Session {
    pub fn new(create_info: SessionCreateInfo) -> Result<Self, SessionCreationError> {
        let udp = create_info.graphics_binding.get_udp();
        let latest_pose_data = Arc::new(RwLock::new(None));
        let shutdown_signal = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        
        // Start pose data receiver thread
        let udp_clone = Arc::clone(&udp);
        let pose_clone = Arc::clone(&latest_pose_data);
        let shutdown_clone = Arc::clone(&shutdown_signal);
        
        let thread = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            Self::pose_receiver_thread(udp_clone, pose_clone, shutdown_clone);
        });
        
        Ok(Self {
            system_id: create_info.system_id,
            state: SessionState::Ready,
            udp,
            latest_pose_data,
            pose_receiver_thread: Some(thread),
            shutdown_signal,
        })
    }
    
    fn pose_receiver_thread(
        udp: Arc<UdpComm>,
        pose_data: Arc<RwLock<Option<WinlatorPoseData>>>,
        shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    ) {
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 4096];
        
        while !shutdown.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            match udp.receiver.recv_from(&mut buffer) {
                Ok((len, _addr)) => {
                    if let Ok(data_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&buffer[..len]) {
                        if let Ok(pose) = parse_winlator_pose(data_str) {
                            let mut writer = pose_data.write().unwrap();
                            *writer = Some(pose);
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(ref e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    log::error!("Pose receive error: {:?}", e);
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    pub fn get_latest_pose(&self) -> Option<WinlatorPoseData> {
        self.latest_pose_data.read().unwrap().clone()
    }
}

fn parse_winlator_pose(data: &str) -> Result<WinlatorPoseData, ParseError> {
    // Parse space-delimited format:
    // LQx LQy LQz LQw LThumbX LThumbY Lx Ly Lz 
    // RQx RQy RQz RQw RThumbX RThumbY Rx Ry Rz 
    // HQx HQy HQz HQw Hx Hy Hz IPD FOVH FOVV FrameID Buttons
    
    let parts: Vec<&str> = data.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 28 {
        return Err(ParseError::InvalidFormat);
    }
    
    let buttons_str = if parts.len() > 28 { parts[28] } else { "" };
    
    Ok(WinlatorPoseData {
        left_hand_quat: Quat::from_array([
            parts[0].parse()?,
            parts[1].parse()?,
            parts[2].parse()?,
            parts[3].parse()?,
        ]),
        left_hand_thumb: Vec2::new(parts[4].parse()?, parts[5].parse()?),
        left_hand_pos: Vec3::new(parts[6].parse()?, parts[7].parse()?, parts[8].parse()?),
        
        right_hand_quat: Quat::from_array([
            parts[9].parse()?,
            parts[10].parse()?,
            parts[11].parse()?,
            parts[12].parse()?,
        ]),
        right_hand_thumb: Vec2::new(parts[13].parse()?, parts[14].parse()?),
        right_hand_pos: Vec3::new(parts[15].parse()?, parts[16].parse()?, parts[17].parse()?),
        
        hmd_quat: Quat::from_array([
            parts[18].parse()?,
            parts[19].parse()?,
            parts[20].parse()?,
            parts[21].parse()?,
        ]),
        hmd_pos: Vec3::new(parts[22].parse()?, parts[23].parse()?, parts[24].parse()?),
        
        ipd: parts[25].parse()?,
        fov_h: parts[26].parse()?,
        fov_v: parts[27].parse()?,
        frame_id: parts.get(28).and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
        
        buttons: parse_winlator_buttons(buttons_str)?,
    })
}

fn parse_winlator_buttons(buttons_str: &str) -> Result<[bool; 19], ParseError> {
    let mut buttons = [false; 19];
    for (i, ch) in buttons_str.chars().enumerate() {
        if i >= 19 {
            break;
        }
        buttons[i] = ch == 'T';
    }
    Ok(buttons)
}

Space and Pose Tracking:

impl Space {
    pub fn locate(&self, base_space: &Space, time: XrTime) -> SpaceLocation {
        let session = self.session.upgrade()
            .expect("Session was dropped");
        
        if let Some(pose) = session.get_latest_pose() {
            match self.space_type {
                ReferenceSpaceType::View => {
                    SpaceLocation {
                        pose: XrPosef {
                            orientation: pose.hmd_quat,
                            position: pose.hmd_pos,
                        },
                        position_valid: true,
                        orientation_valid: true,
                    }
                }
                ReferenceSpaceType::Local | ReferenceSpaceType::Stage => {
                    // Convert to local/stage space if needed
                    // For now, return same as view space
                    SpaceLocation {
                        pose: XrPosef {
                            orientation: pose.hmd_quat,
                            position: pose.hmd_pos,
                        },
                        position_valid: true,
                        orientation_valid: true,
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            SpaceLocation {
                pose: XrPosef::IDENTITY,
                position_valid: false,
                orientation_valid: false,
            }
        }
    }
}

View Management with WinlatorXR Data:

impl Session {
    pub fn locate_views(&self, _display_time: XrTime, view_type: ViewConfigurationType) -> (Vec<View>, ViewStateFlags) {
        if let Some(pose) = self.get_latest_pose() {
            let fov_h_rad = (pose.fov_h / 2.0).to_radians();
            let fov_v_rad = (pose.fov_v / 2.0).to_radians();
            
            let half_ipd = pose.ipd * 0.5;
            
            let left_view = View {
                pose: XrPosef {
                    orientation: pose.hmd_quat,
                    position: pose.hmd_pos + Vec3::new(-half_ipd, 0.0, 0.0),
                },
                fov: XrFovf {
                    angle_left: -fov_h_rad,
                    angle_right: fov_h_rad,
                    angle_up: fov_v_rad,
                    angle_down: -fov_v_rad,
                },
            };
            
            let right_view = View {
                pose: XrPosef {
                    orientation: pose.hmd_quat,
                    position: pose.hmd_pos + Vec3::new(half_ipd, 0.0, 0.0),
                },
                fov: XrFovf {
                    angle_left: -fov_h_rad,
                    angle_right: fov_h_rad,
                    angle_up: fov_v_rad,
                    angle_down: -fov_v_rad,
                },
            };
            
            (vec![left_view, right_view], ViewStateFlags {
                position_valid: true,
                orientation_valid: true,
            })
        } else {
            (vec![Self::default_view(), Self::default_view()], ViewStateFlags {
                position_valid: false,
                orientation_valid: false,
            })
        }
    }
    
    fn default_view() -> View {
        View {
            pose: XrPosef::IDENTITY,
            fov: XrFovf {
                angle_left: -1.0,
                angle_right: 1.0,
                angle_up: 1.0,
                angle_down: -1.0,
            },
        }
    }
}

Haptic Feedback Implementation:

impl Session {
    pub fn send_haptic(&self, data: WinlatorHapticData) -> Result<(), SessionCreationError> {
        let sbs_flag = if data.sbs_flag { "1" } else { "0" };
        
        let message = format!(
            "{} {} 1 {} {} {}",
            data.left_vibration.to_string(),
            data.right_vibration.to_string(),
            sbs_flag,
            data.target_fov_w.to_string(),
            data.target_fov_h.to_string()
        );
        
        let target = SocketAddr::V4(SocketAddrV4::new(self.udp.target_ip, 7278));
        self.udp.transmitter.send_to(message.as_bytes(), target)
            .map_err(|e| SessionCreationError::InitializationFailed(e.to_string()))?;
        
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Action<T> {
    pub fn apply_feedback(&self, session: &Session, haptic: HapticVibration) -> Result<(), SessionCreationError> {
        let haptic_data = WinlatorHapticData {
            left_vibration: haptic.amplitude,
            right_vibration: haptic.amplitude,
            sbs_flag: false,
            target_fov_w: 104.5,
            target_fov_h: 104.5,
        };
        
        session.send_haptic(haptic_data)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

Frame Management:

impl Session {
    pub fn wait_frame(&mut self) -> Result<(FrameWaiter, XrTime), SessionCreationError> {
        // Poll for new frame ID from pose data
        let last_frame = Arc::new(AtomicU8::new(0));
        let last_frame_clone = Arc::clone(&last_frame);
        
        loop {
            if let Some(pose) = self.get_latest_pose() {
                if pose.frame_id != last_frame_clone.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                    last_frame_clone.store(pose.frame_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    return Ok((
                        FrameWaiter,
                        self.udp.instance_ref.now(),
                    ));
                }
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
        }
    }
    
    pub fn end_frame(&mut self, layers: &[CompositionLayerBase]) -> Result<(), SessionCreationError> {
        // Send frame completion with SBS flag
        let is_sbs = layers.iter().any(|layer| matches!(layer, CompositionLayerBase::Projection(_)));
        
        let haptic_data = WinlatorHapticData {
            left_vibration: 0.0,
            right_vibration: 0.0,
            sbs_flag: is_sbs,
            target_fov_w: 104.5,
            target_fov_h: 104.5,
        };
        
        self.send_haptic(haptic_data)
    }
}

Input/Action System Integration:

impl Session {
    pub fn sync_actions(&self, _action_sets: &[ActiveActionSet]) -> Result<(), SessionCreationError> {
        // Update button states from latest pose data
        if let Some(pose) = self.get_latest_pose() {
            // Store button states for action queries
            self.store_button_states(pose.buttons);
            
            // Store thumbstick axes
            self.store_thumbstick_axes(Hand::Left, pose.left_hand_thumb);
            self.store_thumbstick_axes(Hand::Right, pose.right_hand_thumb);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

Phase 3: DirectX 11 Graphics Backend

3.1 Create DirectX 11 Backend

New File: src/graphics_backends/directx11.rs

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::*;
use windows::core::*;

pub struct DirectX11Data {
    device: ID3D11Device,
    context: ID3D11DeviceContext,
    swapchains: HashMap<u32, SwapchainData>,
}

struct SwapchainData {
    texture: ID3D11Texture2D,
    shader_resource_view: ID3D11ShaderResourceView,
    render_target_view: ID3D11RenderTargetView,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
}

impl GraphicsBackend for DirectX11Data {
    type Api = DirectX11;
    
    fn new() -> Result<Self, GraphicsError> {
        unsafe {
            // Create Direct3D 11 device
            let mut device = None;
            let mut context = None;
            
            D3D11CreateDevice(
                None,
                D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE,
                None,
                D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_DEBUG,
                None,
                D3D11_SDK_VERSION,
                &mut device,
                None,
                &mut context,
            )?;
            
            Ok(Self {
                device: device.unwrap(),
                context: context.unwrap(),
                swapchains: HashMap::new(),
            })
        }
    }
    
    fn swapchain_info_for_texture(
        &self,
        texture: &vr::Texture_t,
        bounds: &vr::VRTextureBounds_t,
        _color_space: vr::EColorSpace,
    ) -> SwapchainCreateInfo<Self::Api> {
        let extent = self.get_texture_extent(texture);
        
        SwapchainCreateInfo {
            width: extent.width,
            height: extent.height,
            format: DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM.0 as u64,
            sample_count: 1,
        }
    }
    
    fn copy_texture_to_swapchain(
        &mut self,
        eye: Eye,
        texture: &vr::Texture_t,
        bounds: &vr::VRTextureBounds_t,
        image_index: u32,
        flags: vr::EVRSubmitFlags,
    ) -> Extent2Di {
        unsafe {
            let src_texture = self.get_d3d11_texture(texture);
            let dst_swapchain = self.swapchains.get_mut(&image_index)
                .expect("Invalid swapchain index");
            
            // Copy texture using Direct3D 11
            let src_box = D3D11_BOX {
                left: (bounds.uMin * dst_swapchain.width as f32) as u32,
                top: (bounds.vMin * dst_swapchain.height as f32) as u32,
                front: 0,
                right: (bounds.uMax * dst_swapchain.width as f32) as u32,
                bottom: (bounds.vMax * dst_swapchain.height as f32) as u32,
                back: 1,
            };
            
            self.context.CopySubresourceRegion(
                &dst_swapchain.texture,
                0,
                0, 0, 0,
                src_texture,
                0,
                &src_box,
            );
            
            Extent2Di {
                width: dst_swapchain.width as i32,
                height: dst_swapchain.height as i32,
            }
        }
    }
    
    fn create_swapchain(&mut self, create_info: SwapchainCreateInfo<Self::Api>) -> Result<u64, GraphicsError> {
        unsafe {
            let desc = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC {
                Width: create_info.width,
                Height: create_info.height,
                MipLevels: 1,
                ArraySize: 1,
                Format: DXGI_FORMAT(create_info.format as u32),
                SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                    Count: create_info.sample_count,
                    Quality: 0,
                },
                Usage: D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT,
                BindFlags: D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE.0 | D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET.0,
                CPUAccessFlags: D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_FLAG(0),
                MiscFlags: D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_FLAG(0),
            };
            
            let mut texture = None;
            self.device.CreateTexture2D(&desc, None, &mut texture)?;
            
            let mut srv_desc = D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC::default();
            srv_desc.Format = desc.Format;
            srv_desc.ViewDimension = D3D11_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            srv_desc.Anonymous.Texture2D = D3D11_TEX2D_SRV {
                MostDetailedMip: 0,
                MipLevels: 1,
            };
            
            let mut srv = None;
            self.device.CreateShaderResourceView(&texture.as_ref().unwrap(), &srv_desc, &mut srv)?;
            
            let mut rtv = None;
            self.device.CreateRenderTargetView(&texture.as_ref().unwrap(), None, &mut rtv)?;
            
            let swapchain_id = self.swapchains.len() as u64;
            self.swapchains.insert(swapchain_id as u32, SwapchainData {
                texture: texture.unwrap(),
                shader_resource_view: srv.unwrap(),
                render_target_view: rtv.unwrap(),
                width: create_info.width,
                height: create_info.height,
            });
            
            Ok(swapchain_id)
        }
    }
}

impl DirectX11Data {
    unsafe fn get_d3d11_texture(&self, texture: &vr::Texture_t) -> &ID3D11Texture2D {
        &*(texture.handle as *const ID3D11Texture2D)
    }
    
    unsafe fn get_texture_extent(&self, texture: &vr::Texture_t) -> Extent2D {
        let d3d_texture = self.get_d3d11_texture(texture);
        let mut desc = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC::default();
        d3d_texture.GetDesc(&mut desc);
        
        Extent2D {
            width: desc.Width,
            height: desc.Height,
        }
    }
}

pub struct DirectX11;

impl Graphics for DirectX11 {
    type SwapchainInfo = SwapchainCreateInfo<DirectX11>;
    type SwapchainImageData = ID3D11Texture2D;
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum SupportedBackend {
    DirectX11(DirectX11Data),
    Vulkan(VulkanData),
    #[cfg(test)]
    Fake(FakeGraphicsData),
}

supported_backends_enum!(enum AnyTempBackendData: TempBackendData);

impl TempBackendData<DirectX11Data> {
    pub fn new(backend: DirectX11Data, _swapchain_create_info: Option<SwapchainCreateInfo<DirectX11>>) -> Self {
        Self::DirectX11(backend)
    }
}

pub fn supported_backends_enum(input: SupportedBackend) -> Option<AnyTempBackendData> {
    match input {
        SupportedBackend::DirectX11(data) => Some(AnyTempBackendData::DirectX11(TempBackendData::new(data, None))),
        SupportedBackend::Vulkan(data) => Some(AnyTempBackendData::Vulkan(TempBackendData::new(data, None))),
        #[cfg(test)]
        SupportedBackend::Fake(data) => Some(AnyTempBackendData::Fake(TempBackendData::new(data, None))),
    }
}

pub fn select_preferred_backend() -> Option<SupportedBackend> {
    // Try DirectX 11 first
    if let Ok(dx11) = DirectX11Data::new() {
        log::info!("Using DirectX 11 backend");
        return Some(SupportedBackend::DirectX11(dx11));
    }
    
    // Fallback to Vulkan
    if let Ok(vulkan) = VulkanData::new() {
        log::info!("Using Vulkan backend (DirectX 11 unavailable)");
        return Some(SupportedBackend::Vulkan(vulkan));
    }
    
    log::error!("No suitable graphics backend found");
    None
}

    pub instance: Instance,  // From winlatorxr
    pub system_id: SystemId,
    pub session_data: SessionReadGuard,
    pub display_time: AtomicXrTime,
    pub display_period_nanos: AtomicI64,
    pub enabled_extensions: ExtensionSet,

    pub(crate) input: Injected<crate::input::Input<C>>,
    pub(crate) compositor: Injected<C>,
}

impl<C: Compositor> WxrData<C> {
    pub fn new(injector: &Injector) -> Result<Self, InitError> {
        let instance = Instance::new()
            .map_err(|e| InitError::InitializationFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let system_id = instance.system_id;

        let session_data = SessionReadGuard(RwLock::new(ManuallyDrop::new(
            SessionData::new(
                &instance,
                system_id,
                vr::ETrackingUniverseOrigin::Standing,
                None,
            )?
            .0,
        )));

        let display_time = instance.now().0;

        let mut enabled_extensions = ExtensionSet::default();
        // WinlatorXR doesn't support these extensions
        enabled_extensions.visibility_mask = false;
        enabled_extensions.display_refresh_rate = false;
        enabled_extensions.hand_tracking = false;

        Ok(Self {
            instance,
            system_id,
            session_data,
            display_time: AtomicXrTime(display_time.into()),
            display_period_nanos: 11111111.into(),
            enabled_extensions,
            input: injector.inject(),
            compositor: injector.inject(),
        })
    }

    // Remove OpenXR-specific methods
    // pub fn poll_events(&self) { ... }  // REMOVE
    // pub fn restart_session(&self) { ... }  // REMOVE or adapt
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_udp_communication_initialization() {
        let udp = UdpComm::new();
        assert!(udp.is_ok(), "UDP communication should initialize");

    #[test]
    fn test_winlator_pose_parsing() {
        let sample = "0.213 0.287 -0.933 0.035 0.0 0.0 -0.008 -0.229 -0.173 0.095 -0.296 0.947 -0.077 0.0 0.0 0.154 -0.240 -0.140 0.146 -0.072 0.048 0.985 0.037 0.006 -0.017 0.0678 99.00 103.40 224 TFFFFFFFFFTTTFFFFFT";
        
        let pose = parse_winlator_pose(sample);
        assert!(pose.is_ok(), "Should parse valid pose data");
        
        let pose = pose.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(pose.frame_id, 224);
        assert_eq!(pose.fov_h, 99.00);
        assert_eq!(pose.fov_v, 103.40);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_instance_creation() {
        let instance = Instance::new();
        assert!(instance.is_ok(), "Instance should create successfully");
        
        let instance = instance.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(instance.refresh_rate, 90.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_session_creation() {
        let instance = Instance::new().unwrap();
        let create_info = SessionCreateInfo {
            system_id: instance.system_id,
            graphics_binding: GraphicsBinding::Vulkan(VulkanGraphicsBinding {
                instance: ash::Instance::null(),
                physical_device: ash::vk::PhysicalDevice::null(),
                device: ash::Device::null(),
                queue_family_index: 0,
                queue_index: 0,
            }),
        };
        
        let session = Session::new(create_info);
        assert!(session.is_ok(), "Session should create successfully");
        
        let session = session.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(session.state, SessionState::Ready);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_haptic_data_formatting() {
        let haptic = WinlatorHapticData {
            left_vibration: 0.5,
            right_vibration: 0.75,
            sbs_flag: true,
            target_fov_w: 104.5,
            target_fov_h: 104.5,
        };
        
        let sbs_flag = if haptic.sbs_flag { "1" } else { "0" };
        let message = format!(
            "{} {} 1 {} {} {}",
            haptic.left_vibration,
            haptic.right_vibration,
            sbs_flag,
            haptic.target_fov_w,
            haptic.target_fov_h
        );
        
        assert_eq!(message, "0.5 0.75 1 1 104.5 104.5");
    }
}

Phase 8: Documentation

8.1 Update README.md
# xrizer-wxr - OpenVR to WinlatorXR Bridge

xrizer-wxr is a modified version of xrizer that converts OpenVR calls to WinlatorXR XrAPI UDP protocol instead of OpenXR. This enables OpenVR applications to run on WinlatorXR without requiring OpenXR runtime.

## Requirements

- **Windows OS** (this is Windows-only software)
- WinlatorXR on Meta Quest 3, Pico, or Play For Dream device
- WinlatorXR container running Windows application

## Installation

1. Build xrizer-wxr:
   ```bash
   cargo build --release
2. Copy the built DLL to your WinlatorXR container:
target/release/xrizer_wxr.dll -> /path/to/winlatorxr/container/
3. Set environment variable in your WinlatorXR container:
export VR_OVERRIDE=/path/to/xrizer_wxr.dll
4. Launch your OpenVR application
WinlatorXR UDP Protocol
Pose Data (Receive)
- Port: 7872 (fallback to 7873)
- Format: Space-delimited values
- Data: HMD pose, controller poses, button states, FOV, IPD, frame ID
Haptic Data (Send)
- Port: 7278
- Target: 127.0.0.1
- Format: <left_vib> <right_vib> <flag> <sbs_flag> <fov_w> <fov_h>
Graphics Backend
- Primary: DirectX 11
- Fallback: Vulkan
- OpenGL: Not supported (removed for Windows-only implementation)
Platform
Windows Only
All Linux-specific code has been removed. This software will not compile or run on Linux.
Supported Features
- 6DOF head and hand tracking
- Controller button inputs (19 buttons)
- Thumbstick axes (left and right)
- Haptic feedback
- Stereo rendering (SBS mode)
- Dynamic FOV adjustment
- Frame synchronization via frame ID
Environment Variables
- RUST_LOG - Logging level control
- XRIZER_WXR_UDP_POSE_PORT - Override pose data port (default: 7872)
- XRIZER_WXR_UDP_HAPTIC_PORT - Override haptic data port (default: 7278)
- XRIZER_WXR_TARGET_IP - Override target IP (default: 127.0.0.1)
Building
# Release build
cargo build --release

# Debug build
cargo build
Testing
# Run unit tests
cargo test

# Test compilation
cargo build --release
License
GPL-3.0-or-later
Credits
Based on xrizer by Supreeeme (https://github.com/Supreeeme/xrizer)
WinlatorXR by lvonasek and contributors (https://github.com/WinlatorXR/WinlatorXR)
